record.Description: This recall involves X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows, model number NP001. The nursing pillows are C-shaped and sold in white with leaves pattern, dark brown with multicolored feather pattern and multicolored puzzle piece pattern. There are no markings or labels on the product.
record.Title: Kikea Store Recalls X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows
record.ConsumerContact: Kikea Store by email at zsally929@gmail.com.

Products.Name: X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows
Products.Type: Infant Bedding- Blankets, Pads, Pillows, Sheets, Etc

Images.Caption: Recalled X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillow – in white with leaves pattern, dark brown with multicolored feather pattern and multicolored puzzle piece pattern.

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from April 2025 through June 2026 for between $24 and $34.
Shenzhen Yiyi Jiajia Trading Co., Ltd., doing business asKikea Store, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant’s breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled nursing pillows immediately and contact Kikea Store for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pillow in half after confirming the recalled pillow with the firm and send a photo of the destroyed pillow to zsally929@gmail.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product.
